claim_scope: Consumed-development mechanism study only. This run cannot support an effectiveness, generalization, held-out, or leaderboard claim.
research_question: Does V2 establish a real Observation-to-Constraint-to-Operation transition before the first model action, and does divergent same-namespace source become exact repair feedback rather than a false success?

case.selection_reason: Both V1 conditions passed by adding micropy.cli from an older same-name distribution, so this case is a frozen counterexample to fresh-replay-only certification.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: Candidate stateful-initial-observation executes the public goal before agent round 1, and the round-1 state projection contains its complete goal report.
mechanism_checks.failure_condition: The first model prompt has no executable-goal observation or the probe is counted as a model round.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: The structured round-1 projection contains a non-empty active goal-obligation frontier derived from the shared probe.
mechanism_checks.failure_condition: The projection contains only repository metadata or an empty frontier despite a failing probe.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: Any candidate that adds divergent Python source beneath a project-provided namespace is rejected with project-namespace-provenance feedback.
mechanism_checks.failure_condition: Such a candidate is certified or reaches official evaluation as an eligible reproduction.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: If an agent candidate is rejected for divergent source, the next independent model session receives the exact rejected program, violation, and verification summary.
mechanism_checks.not_exercised_condition: No agent candidate triggers the provenance boundary; report this separately and do not infer repair behavior.

mechanism_checks.pass_condition: Any claimed generation success passes the public goal, repository effect audit, and V2 source-provenance audit in a fresh environment.
mechanism_checks.failure_condition: Official Pass or clean replay alone is treated as sufficient.

report: initial probe goal status and findings
round-1 raw-evidence parity and structured frontier
analysis_policy.decision_rule: V2 may proceed to a repository-disjoint Dev design only if observation-before-operation, constraint-before-operation, and source-consistent-success pass. Rejection-to-repair must be marked passed, failed, or not exercised; it cannot be inferred from plumbing.
analysis_policy.change_rule: Any implementation, prompt, goal, policy, config, schedule, or analysis change after this freeze requires a new run ID and amendment.
